programme.desc: On the run in the year 1987, Bumblebee finds refuge in a junkyard in a small California beach town. On the cusp of turning 18 and trying to find her place in the world, Charlie Watson discovers Bumblebee, battle-scarred and broken.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Devoted lifeguard Mitch Buchannon butts heads with a brash new recruit, as they uncover a criminal plot that threatens the future of the bay.

programme.title: The Forbidden Kingdom
programme.desc: A discovery made by a kung fu obsessed American teen sends him on an adventure to China, where he joins up with a band of martial arts warriors in order to free the imprisoned Monkey King.

programme.title: click
programme.desc: A workaholic architect finds a universal remote that allows him to fast-forward and rewind to different parts of his life. Complications arise when the remote starts to overrule his choices.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: A shy student trying to reach his family in Ohio, a gun-toting tough guy trying to find the last Twinkie, and a pair of sisters trying to get to an amusement park join forces to travel across a zombie-filled America.

programme.title: The.Lovely.Bones
programme.desc: Centers on a young girl who has been murdered and watches over her family - and her killer - from purgatory. She must weigh her desire for vengeance against her desire for her family to heal.

programme.title: Stuart Little 3 Call Of The Wild
programme.desc: The Little family spend their vacation near Lake Garland. Meanwhile, in the forest, a beast is threatening the animals to give her food every night.

programme.title: The.X.Files:I.Want.To.Believe.
programme.desc: Mulder and Scully are called back to duty by the FBI when a former priest claims to be receiving psychic visions pertaining to a kidnapped agent.

programme.desc: 160 elite U.S. soldiers drop into Somalia to capture two top lieutenants of a renegade warlord and find themselves in a desperate battle with a large force of heavily-armed Somalis.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: A skilled London police officer, after irritating superiors with his embarrassing effectiveness, is transferred to a village where the easygoing officers object to his fervor for regulations, as a string of grisly murders strikes the town.

programme.title: Wifelike

Depois de jurar vingança, ela vai viver para os EUA com a única família que lhe resta: o seu tio Emilio Restrepo (Cliff Curtis), um homem ligado ao submundo do crime. Quinze anos depois de uma vida difícil de treino intensivo, Cataleya trabalha como assassina a soldo. Porém, presa ao passado, ela está determinada a cumprir a sua promessa e todos os momentos da sua vida servem para o simples propósito de vingar a morte dos pais, mesmo sabendo que isso signifique perder tudo o que conquistou. programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: 1992. Bogotá, Colômbia. Com apenas nove anos, Cataleya (Zoe Saldana) assiste, impotente, ao brutal assassinato dos seus pais. Depois de jurar vingança, ela vai viver para os EUA com a única família que lhe resta: o seu tio Emilio Restrepo (Cliff Curtis), um homem ligado ao submundo do crime. Quinze anos depois de uma vida difícil de treino intensivo, Cataleya trabalha como assassina a soldo. Porém, presa ao passado, ela está determinada a cumprir a sua promessa e todos os momentos da sua vida servem para o simples propósito de vingar a morte dos pais, mesmo sabendo que isso signifique perder tudo o que conquistou. Um "thriller" de acção realizado por Olivier Megaton ("Exit", "Transporter - Correio de Risco 3") que conta com Luc Besson e Robert Mark Kamen como argumentistas.

programme.title: Perseguição Sem Tréguas 2
